verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Salesforce exposes APIs ("Discover Salesforce APIs & put them to work") and that its official CLI can query records (`sf data query`). That is a glancing indication that records can be read programmatically, with nothing on writing them back at scale. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable API spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API rate limits, upsert or external-ID write semantics, change detection (CDC/events/polling), bulk or at-scale sync documentation, evidence of bidirectional write-back, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
